pride_data.title: Cross-linking mass spectrometry of DMXL1-mNG immunoprecipitated complex
pride_data.projectDescription: To capture protein interactions, cross-linking experiments were performed on immune complexes prepared by affinity-purification of DMXL1-mNG from U2OS cells.
pride_data.sampleProcessingProtocol: DMXL1-mNG was immunoprecipitated on magnetic agarose beads conjugated with a nanobody against mNG. DMXL1-mNG immune complexes were cross-linked on beads by incubating 1mM DSSO at room temperature for 40min. Reaction was quenched with 50mM Tris buffer pH 7.6 at room temperature for 30min. Cross-linked proteins was denatured in  2M urea, reduced with 5mM TCEP, alkylated with 15mM iodoacetamide, and quenched with 15mM DTT. Cross-linked proteins were digested with LysC/Trypsin. Peptides were desalted with a 50mg C8 Sep-Pak column and fractionated by strong cation exchange (SCX) chromatography. A 70-min linear gradient of mobile phase (0.5M NaCl in 20% ACN, 0.05% formic acid) was used. Fractions were collected between 30min and 60min, dried in a SpeedVac and desalted using C8 StageTip. Unfractionated and 11 pooled fractionated samples were reconstituted in 5% ACN, 5% formic acid and analyzed by LC-MS/MS on a Orbitrap Fusion Lumos mass spectrometer with FAIMSpro. Peptides were fractionated with a 90-min linear gradient of acetonitrile using 100-μm C18 capillary column. An HCD-MS2 strategy was used, in which peptides with charge states 4-8 were fragmented by HCD at 21, 27 and 33% normalized collision energy and MS2 was acquired on the Orbitrap. FAIMS Pro was set to -50, -60 and -75 CV.
pride_data.dataProcessingProtocol: Data was searched using Thermo Proteome Discoverer (version 2.5.0.400) with the XlinkX module against the human canonical proteome (Uniprot Swiss-Prot 2022-05). MS2 acquisition strategy was selected with 10ppm precursor mass tolerance and 20ppm FTMS fragment mass tolerance. Carbamidomethylation was included as fixed modification; oxidation and N-terminal acetylation were included as variable modifications. A maximum of 3 trypsin miscleavages were allowed and 5 minimum peptide length. FDR threshold was set to 5%.
